targets.label: User Temp Files
targets.note: Temporary files created by apps under %TEMP%. Safe to remove.

targets.label: Windows Prefetch Cache
targets.note: Application launch index caches under C:\Windows\Prefetch.

targets.label: Windows Update Download Cache
targets.note: Downloaded Windows Update installation files under SoftwareDistribution\Download.

targets.label: Windows Crash Dumps
targets.note: Application crash logs and memory dumps under %LOCALAPPDATA%\CrashDumps.

targets.label: NuGet Package Cache
targets.note: .NET package cache under %USERPROFILE%\.nuget\packages. Re-downloaded on build.

targets.label: Gradle Build Cache
targets.note: Android and Java Gradle cache under %USERPROFILE%\.gradle\caches.

targets.label: HuggingFace Cache
targets.note: Downloaded model weights and tokenizers under %USERPROFILE%\.cache\huggingface.

targets.label: VS Code Caches
targets.note: VS Code code and extension caches under %APPDATA%\Code\Cache.

targets.label: Microsoft Edge Cache
targets.note: Edge browser web and service worker caches under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Edge.

targets.label: WSL2 & Docker VHDX Shrinker
targets.note: Reclaims un-shrunk space in ext4.vhdx and docker_data.vhdx using diskpart compact engine.

targets.label: CapabilityAccessManager Log Bloat
targets.note: Fixes runaway permission logging db-wal file bloat under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages.
